story_overview: Arthur and his associate Silas investigate a mysterious house covered in handwritten wallpaper, observed by police officer Marcus. As they peel back the walls' layers, they make a surprising discovery. The investigation leads Arthur to the cordoned-off house at night, culminating in him crushing a cryptic note in a private study.

video_prompts:
Arthur: Man in a formal black suit and white gloves.
The Manuscript Bathroom: Indoor bathroom with walls covered in handwritten wallpaper, a toilet, and a blue-tiled bathtub.
the handwritten wallpaper: Large sheet of white paper wallpaper covered with handwritten text.

Inside The Manuscript Bathroom, Arthur stands in the doorway and begins peeling the handwritten wallpaper from the wall.
action_descriptions: Inside The Manuscript Bathroom, Arthur stands in the doorway and begins peeling the handwritten wallpaper from the wall.

video_prompts:
The Cordoned House: The entrance of a house with front steps, cordoned off with yellow police tape.
the police tape: Bright yellow plastic tape with the words "POLICE LINE DO NOT CROSS" printed in bold black capital letters and repeated along its length.
the silver briefcase: An open, hard-shell briefcase with a silver-colored exterior.

Arthur walks towards the house carefully carrying the open silver briefcase, ducks under the police tape, and goes inside. On the front steps, Marcus stands guard, watching Arthur's approach. Silas watches from the sidewalk, with the roof of the parked car in the foreground.
